verdict.rationale: a-Shell has no documented rules or trigger-action system for running actions automatically on events. The relay README summary states plainly that "no trigger-action rules surface exists." The `.profile` startup script is a single fixed customization hook that runs when a window opens, which is an adjacent feature rather than user-defined event rules. Event triggers through Apple Shortcuts would be a host-platform capability, which earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
